QF.id: SIA Social Stock Exchange Introduction and Instruments_23

question.text: A For Profit Social Enterprise (FPE) raising equity on the Indian capital market may list its equity shares on which of the following venues?

answer.text: Only the SSE segment; equity on main board is prohibited for FPSEs.
Main board, SME Platform, or Innovators Growth Platform (IGP), with an identifier indicating the scrip is a 'For Profit Social Enterprise'.

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 2.3.2 and 2.3.2.1, FPEs may list equity on the main board, SME Platform or Innovators Growth Platform (IGP), subject to listing eligibility per segment. SEBI has clarified the scrip carries an identifier stating it is a 'For Profit Social Enterprise'. FPEs comply with standard listing norms PLUS additional social impact disclosure requirements. The Trap: Option A wrongly excludes main board. Options B and D wrongly narrow the choice to a single segment. Cross-Exam Context: XII (Securities Markets Foundation), XV (RA) treat main/SME/IGP segment choice for conventional issuers. III-A/III-C (Compliance) add the FPSE identifier layer. Assessor's Pro-Tip: When assessing an FPSE's impact claims, triangulate against the segment-specific disclosure: IGP issuers disclose less financial detail than main-board, so adjust your MoV (Means of Verification) weight toward the SSE-specific Annual Impact Report rather than generic LODR disclosures.
